env.name: SCHEDULER_STORE_DIR
env.description: Where scheduled-task records and run history are written. Defaults to ./generated/scheduled-tasks/<agent-name> if unset — <agent-name> is inferred from wherever this ability is actually installed, so two agents installing it in the same project default to two separate, non-conflicting stores automatically. Set this explicitly to use one shared store instead (only safe if no more than one agent's own copy of this ability ever points at it).

env.name: SCHEDULER_TICK_INTERVAL_MS
env.description: How often (in milliseconds) the background loop checks for due tasks. Defaults to 10000 (10 seconds) if unset — lower it for tighter timing on short "every" intervals, raise it to reduce filesystem polling on a deployment with many scheduled tasks.
